providers.title: The asymptotic centralizer in the ultrapower
providers.scope: A_{phi,omega} consists of multipliers, M_{phi,omega} embeds in M^omega and commutes with phi^omega, continuous functional calculus and projection lifting work in A_{phi,omega}.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Asymptotic eigenoperators
providers.scope: A bounded sequence with ||v_n phi - lambda phi v_n|| -> 0 is a multiplier, and its class V satisfies V phi^omega = lambda phi^omega V.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Unitaries conjugating states
providers.scope: Unitaries with u_n phi u_n* -> psi in norm give a unitary U of M^omega with U phi^omega U* = psi^omega.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Partial isometries between states
providers.scope: In a type III_1 factor with separable predual, two normal states with supports p, q are carried into each other by a partial isometry from p to q up to 5 sqrt(eps), with defects at most eps.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The asymptotic centralizer is a II_1 factor
providers.scope: For a type III_1 factor with separable predual and any faithful normal state phi, M_{phi,omega} is a II_1 factor.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Approximate eigenoperators
providers.scope: For every lambda > 0 there are partial isometries v_{k,n} with ||v_{k,n} phi - lambda phi v_{k,n}|| -> 0 and sum_k v_{k,n} v_{k,n}* -> 1 *-strongly.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Descriptions of the bicentralizer
providers.scope: B(M,phi) equals its ultrafilter version, the relative commutant of M_{phi,omega} in M^omega, and Haagerup's unitary formulation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Structure of the bicentralizer
providers.scope: B(M,phi) is a von Neumann subalgebra containing the centre, invariant under sigma^phi, with a unique phi-preserving normal expectation, and contained in M_phi' cap M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Self-bicentralizing (Houdayer-Isono)
providers.scope: B(B, phi|_B) = B for B = B(M, phi).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bicentralizers of type III_1 factors
providers.scope: For a type III_1 factor with separable predual, B(M,phi) cap M_phi = C1; B is a factor and phi|_B has trivial centralizer.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Reparametrization test
providers.scope: A bounded sequence whose class in M^omega is unchanged under every reparametrization s(n) -> infinity, for every free ultrafilter, converges *-strongly.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Connes' isomorphism
providers.scope: Conjugation by unitaries moving phi to psi converges on B(M,phi) to a state-compatible isomorphism onto B(M,psi), independent of choices and characterized by asymptotic intertwining.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The bicentralizer flow
providers.scope: A u-continuous phi-preserving action beta^phi of R_+^* on B(M,phi) with w_n x - beta_lambda(x) w_n -> 0 whenever ||w_n phi - lambda phi w_n|| -> 0 (Ando-Haagerup-Houdayer-Marrakchi).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spectral localization controls the predual
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Operator averaging
providers.scope: For an ergodic faithful normal state, the modular average P satisfies P(L(a)) = phi(a) 1 and commutes with the spectral projections of log Delta.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bounded recovery
providers.scope: If M_phi = C, a positive averaged value of ||T U_t h_n||^2 on narrowing spectral bands is witnessed by uniformly bounded v_j in M with ||T v_j xi|| >= eta and comparable bands (OpenAI, 2026).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: State-preserving automorphisms commute with the modular group
providers.scope: If phi o alpha = phi, then alpha commutes with sigma^phi.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Modular eigenvalues of an ergodic state
providers.scope: If M_phi = C, log Delta has no nonzero eigenvalue, and pure point spectrum forces M = C (Marrakchi-Vaes).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spectral intertwining rigidity
providers.scope: If M_phi = C and a continuous phi-preserving action b satisfies the asymptotic intertwining hypothesis, then b is trivial (OpenAI, 2026).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The bicentralizer flow is trivial
providers.scope: For a type III_1 factor with separable predual, beta^phi_lambda = id on B(M,phi) for every lambda.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Haagerup's condition
providers.scope: For every faithful normal state theta, delta > 0 and x with x xi = xi x*, theta(x) = 0, theta(x*x) = 1, some a has ||a||^2 + ||ax||^2 < kappa ||xa - ax||^2 and ||a xi - xi a||^2 < delta ||xa - ax||^2 (norms of theta).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Haagerup's condition passes to corners
providers.scope: The condition is invariant under isomorphisms, so it passes to every nonzero corner of a countably decomposable type III factor.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The local step
providers.scope: Under Haagerup's condition, for a cyclic separating cone vector xi and a self-adjoint unit vector eta orthogonal to it, some a has ||a xi||^2 + ||a eta||^2 < 4 kappa ||a eta - eta a||^2 and ||a xi - xi a||^2 < delta ||a eta - eta a||^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spectral cuts of a self-adjoint element
providers.scope: For e_l = 1_(-inf,l](b): integral of ||e_l zeta - zeta e_l||^2 |l| dl lies between ||b zeta - zeta b||^2/4 and ||b zeta - zeta b|| (||b zeta||^2 + ||zeta b||^2)^{1/2} / sqrt(2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exhaustion
providers.scope: Under Haagerup's condition there are orthogonal projections e_i with sum 1 such that sum e_i xi e_i is delta-close to xi while ||eta - sum e_i eta e_i||^2 >= 2^{-16}/kappa.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Projections nearly commuting with a state
providers.scope: For eta orthogonal to xi there are projections p with ||p xi - xi p||^2 <= delta and ||p eta - eta p||^2 >= 2^{-20} ||eta||^2 / kappa.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Haagerup's criterion
providers.scope: A countably decomposable type III factor satisfying Haagerup's condition has trivial bicentralizer for every faithful normal state (Haagerup 1987; Ando-Haagerup-Houdayer-Marrakchi, Theorem 7.2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Strongly invariant nets
providers.scope: For a bounded net and a strongly continuous isometry group: uniform invariance on compacts, invariance of all averages over probability measures, and approximation by vectors with small generator are equivalent.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Form inequality from approximate eigenstates
providers.scope: If Phi(T) <= 0 for every approximate eigenstate of X, then T (x) 1 <= kappa |A|^2 + eps for the generator A of e^{isX} (x) e^{-isY}, uniformly in Y.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Powers-Stormer inequality for density operators
providers.scope: ||rho^{1/2} - rho'^{1/2}||_2^2 <= ||rho - rho'||_1 for positive trace-class rho, rho'.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Strongly invariant states
providers.scope: A state of B(H) is strongly invariant under Ad e^{itX} exactly when it lies in the closed convex hull of the approximate eigenstates of X (Marrakchi).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Strong fixed points
providers.scope: A nonempty weak*-closed set of states stable under all averages contains a strongly invariant state.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Strongly invariant extensions
providers.scope: A state of C*(M, M') that is invariant and normal on M and on M' extends to a strongly invariant state of B(H) (Marrakchi).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A trivial centralizer forces type III_1
providers.scope: A von Neumann algebra B != C with separable predual and a faithful normal state with trivial centralizer is a factor of type III_1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Eigen-sequences: predual to vectors
providers.scope: ||b_n theta - mu theta b_n|| -> 0 implies ||xi b_n - mu^{-1/2} b_n xi|| -> 0 for bounded (b_n).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bicentralizers have central eigen-isometries
providers.scope: A nontrivial bicentralizer of a separable type III_1 factor is a type III_1 factor with central eigen-isometries for every state and every mu >= 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Absorption
providers.scope: With central eigen-isometries, every barycentre of approximate eigenstates of log Delta agrees on C*(N, N') with a barycentre of limits of vector states a xi with a xi - xi a small.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Central eigen-isometries give Haagerup's condition
providers.scope: A countably decomposable type III factor with central eigen-isometries satisfies Haagerup's condition with constant 2, hence has trivial bicentralizer.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The bicentralizer is trivial
providers.scope: Every type III_1 factor with separable predual has B(M, phi) = C1 for every faithful normal state phi (OpenAI, 2026, with Marrakchi's method).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
